fixes.explanation: That's right, baker. Luke 5:8 says, "When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees." The boats are so full they're beginning to sink. What Simon Peter does is drop down in front of Jesus.
Good guess, baker, but Simon doesn't give that reason. He says, "But because You say so, I will let down the nets." (Luke 5:5). I'd love a fish forecast too, but Simon doesn't hand one out.
